faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start.

items.question: How does course generation work?
items.answer: You provide a title and difficulty level: SallyCourse automatically generates the outline, lessons, articles, video scripts, quizzes and related resources.

items.question: Can I deploy to multiple platforms?
items.answer: Yes, depending on your plan you can deploy simultaneously to Udemy, YouTube, Teachable, Thinkific, Podia, Gumroad, Skillshare and other SCORM-compatible platforms.

items.question: Is the generated content unique?
items.answer: Each course is generated from your title and preferences, producing original content tailored to your topic.

items.question: Can I edit the generated course?
items.answer: Yes, every lesson, quiz and resource remains editable before publishing from your dashboard.

items.question: What happens if I change plans?
items.answer: You can change plans at any time; your existing courses remain available and new limits apply immediately.
